SELECT seq_orders.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO orders ("number", status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, phone, address, consignee, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_status, pack_amount, tableware_number, tableware_status) VALUES (#{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime, jdbcType=NULL}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark, jdbcType=NULL}, #{phone}, #{address, jdbcType=NULL}, #{consignee, jdbcType=NULL}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime, jdbcType=NULL}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{packAmount}, #{tablewareNumber}, #{tablewareStatus})
mapper.select: select * from ( select od.name, sum(od."number") as "number" from order_detail od join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = 5 and o.order_time >= #{begin} and o.order_time <= #{end} group by od.name order by "number" desc ) where rownum <= 10
